title: Smartchime Host Status Contract
description: Host Status published retained by Smartchime to Home Assistant via MQTT (topic: smartchime/host/status) on connect and hourly. Read from what DietPi's own update checks write; Smartchime never runs apt itself.

smartchime_version.description: The running Smartchime release, from the git tag via hatch-vcs.

dietpi.description: The DietPi core version, shaped for a Home Assistant update entity.

installed.description: Installed DietPi version (X.Y.Z) from /boot/dietpi/.version; null if unreadable.

latest.description: The DietPi version available from /run/dietpi/.update_available, or the installed version when no update is available.

apt_updates.description: Pending APT updates from /run/dietpi/.apt_updates, including held kernel/firmware packages. 0 when the file is absent.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, with offset, of when the status was read.
